title: Synthesis Record
subtitle: An electronic music collective platform for DJ producers pushing the boundaries of sound.
description: Synthesis Record is a full-featured platform built for an electronic music collective. It includes artist profiles, music release management, event listings, a merch store, news articles, a photo gallery, and a mailing list. The admin dashboard supports multi-role access with content approval workflows, analytics, and site-wide settings. Built with Next.js, Prisma, and Supabase for a fast, server-rendered experience with real-time data.

title: Ban Sagar
subtitle: The largest Myanmar slang words dictionary — discover, learn, and contribute.
description: Ban Sagar (ဗန်းစကား) is a community-driven Myanmar slang dictionary. Users can browse, search, and contribute Burmese street language, colloquial expressions, and trending slang words. The app features a modern dark-mode interface, real-time search, community submissions, and smooth page transitions. Built with React, Vite, and Supabase with Vercel Analytics for performance monitoring.

title: NMC Configuration Tool
subtitle: APC UPS/PDU network management card serial console automation toolkit.
description: NMC Configuration Tools is a professional desktop utility for configuring APC UPS and PDU Network Management Cards via serial console. It automates the tedious process of manually entering configuration commands, supporting batch configuration with profiles, validation, and automated report generation. Features both a modern GUI built with Flet and a CLI for scripting. Developed for Win-Bells Engineering.

title: Ban Sagar Android
subtitle: The Myanmar slang dictionary in your pocket — native Android companion app.
description: Ban Sagar Android is the native mobile companion to bansagar.com, bringing the Myanmar slang dictionary experience to Android. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3, it features offline caching with Room, real-time sync via Supabase Realtime, Google Sign-In authentication, and Firebase Crashlytics for stability monitoring. The app supports dark/light themes, smooth navigation, and a splash screen for a polished native feel.
